data.current_description:
Set (or change) the account's market, then return the new selection.

The change applies to **every API key this account owns**. The server that handles
the write serves the new market straight away; others may serve the previous
selection for up to a minute, so a request made right after the change can still
reflect the old one. It settles on its own within that minute — wait it out rather
than retrying in a loop. Only single-market plans may set a
market; a plan that already serves all markets gets a 409. The chosen market must
be one a food is actually available in, else a 422.
